name: GeneNetWeaver
description: An in silico benchmark generator that produces realistic synthetic gene regulatory networks and simulated expression data for performance profiling of network inference algorithms.
evaluation_method: AUPR and AUROC (precision-recall and ROC-based metrics) often supplemented by precision/recall and F1
reputation: A well-known in silico benchmark in systems biology for evaluating network inference algorithms, widely used in methodological studies and tool comparisons.
notes: Synthetic networks and simulated expression data may not fully capture real biological complexity; results are sensitive to simulation parameters and may overfit to the generator. Non-LLM benchmark focused on algorithmic network inference.
